mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production, defined as 3 consecutive monthly declines, signals a weakening supply-side environment that will pressure corporate margins and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 3 consecutive monthly declines in INDPRO but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the federal funds rate, defined as a 1pp increase over 3 months, signals a tightening monetary policy that will pressure financial conditions and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises > 1pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts, defined as a 10% drop from the prior month, signals a weakening housing market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST declines > 10% from prior month but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating pace of job growth, defined as the 3-month moving average of PAYEMS rising by > 0.5pp from the prior 3-month period, signals a strengthening labor market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: 3mo MA of PAYEMS rises > 0.5pp from prior 3mo period
failure_condition: 3mo MA of PAYEMS rises > 0.5pp from prior 3mo period but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the CPI inflation rate, defined as the year-over-year change in CPIAUCSL exceeding 4%, signals an overheating economy that will pressure the Fed to tighten policy and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL Y/Y change > 4% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in real estate loan balances, defined as a 5% drop in RSAFS from the prior month, signals a weakening credit environment that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS declines > 5% from prior month but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
